verdict.rationale: Omnara documents a REST API, a TypeScript SDK, a CLI, a published OpenAPI spec and a changelog. None of the evidence shows API version identifiers, versioned endpoints, or a documented deprecation policy. A changelog and an OpenAPI file are related to this story but are not themselves versioning or deprecation guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
